title: Southern US Culinary Culture
summary: Southern US: black pepper, cornbread, butter.
origins: Southern US cuisine reflects american geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Regional pride — smoke, cast iron, and generous portions with table-side adjustment.
teaching: Smoke and spice rubs, fond from cast iron, vinegar or hot sauce at the table for balance.
Cast iron, BBQ sauce, chili powder, and good black pepper.
Signature pairing: black pepper + cornbread + butter.
